newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADRs mixed, Rhone-Poulenc off.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADRs mixed, Rhone-Poulenc off.

text.p: Shares of French chemical group Rhone-Poulenc SA were down 3/4 at 27-3/8 after the company issued a profit warning.

Rhone Poulenc's U.S. unit Rhone-Poulenc Rorer also said its 50 percent owned unit Centeon was voluntarily recalling all in-date lots of its Albuminar and Plasma Plex albumin products as a precaution against bacterial infection.
Albumin is a volume expander that is often used in critical care settings, such as surgery and the treatment of shock, trauma and burns.
Rhone-Poulenc Rorer shares fell 2-5/8 to 71 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Israeli ADRs followed through on a drop in the Tel Aviv stock market, which closed two percent lower on Thursday in thin trading amid sales by mutual funds.
ECI Telecom Ltd was down one at 20-3/8.
